name: Take Cover grants target unit stealth and makes it distant
notes: Take Cover's element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 5-reserve cost is paid; control then passes straight to the opponent's EffectStackOpponentResponse window (no separate active-player window first), so a single P2 PASS resolves the stack before the ability's own MZCHOOSE target decision appears. Choosing the seeded Dungeon Guide tags it with both STEALTH and DISTANT.

rulesClauses: Target unit you control gains stealth until end of turn. That unit also becomes distant.
